about_the_game:
Jeans on Toast, an unhinged choose your own adventure game in the style of classic 80s text-based games where you become inflicted with a terrible curse. A curse that turns every beans on toast you make into a much less edible Jeans on Toast! Forge your own path through a strange and dangerous world to learn the secrets of the Jean Curse and to find the cure you're so desperately wanting for... if there even is a cure...

Get a taste of the madness with this short demo featuring two unique endings and one whole route of Corgi City.

content_descriptors.notes: Pretty much the only mature content in the demo specifically is various curse words which appear throughout and a lot of references to death including some graphic descriptions. However, no death or graphic content is actually shown onscreen. E.g: right at the start you can get bitten by a spider and die but you literally just see an image of a spider and the text does the rest.
